phaseAudits.title: Current Daynori web/PWA readiness audit and critical core fixes
phaseAudits.previousClaim: Audited and verified the full core organizer web/PWA experience across 8 distinct real user journeys
phaseAudits.groundTruth: Automated Vitest/Fastify integration tests (tests/e2e/phase104-v2-web-pwa-audit-journeys.test.ts) using synthetic test accounts (synthetic-alice-104@example.org, etc.); no real human users participated
phaseAudits.correctedClaim: Audited and verified the full core organizer web/PWA experience across 8 distinct synthetic persona user journeys using automated test credentials; real human usability evaluation is governed by release gate DEF-V2-013 and remains strictly blocked

phaseAudits.title: Daynori web/PWA visual refinement and modern interface overhaul
phaseAudits.previousClaim: Captured 80 baseline and 80 post-refinement screenshots across light and dark themes without specifying execution harness
phaseAudits.groundTruth: Automated headless Chrome CDP script (scripts/capture-phase105-visual-evidence.mjs) capturing synthetic viewport sizes and programmatic token WCAG AA contrast evaluations; no human visual inspection on physical monitors
phaseAudits.correctedClaim: Light and dark theme captures collected via automated headless Chrome CDP emulation across standard viewports with programmatic token contrast checks; no physical display or human visual evaluation claimed

phaseAudits.title: Daynori native Android interface refinement and component overhaul
phaseAudits.previousClaim: Executed 12-step verification script on Android emulator verifying Today, Plan, Library, Journal, Settings, Create, Assistant, Dark mode, Large text scaling, Landscape, Account switching, and Workspace isolation
phaseAudits.groundTruth: Inspection of scripts/phase106-android-evidence.mjs confirms the 12 adb emulator steps tested Today, Plan, Library, Create sheet, Back nav create, Settings hub, Back nav settings, Assistant gated truthful, Large text (1.3x), Landscape, Account isolation assertion, and Settings restored. There was NO dark mode step in the emulator script (dark theme tokens were tested in headless unit tests only). Physical ARM64 phone and spoken TalkBack were unavailable
phaseAudits.correctedClaim: 12-step emulator verification on emulator-5554 covered Today, Plan, Library, Create, Settings, Back navigation, Assistant gating, Large text, Landscape, and Account isolation. Dark theme tokens were evaluated in headless unit tests only (no adb dark mode toggle). Physical ARM64 hardware and spoken TalkBack remain strictly unavailable and blocked under DEF-V2-011 and Phase 71

phaseAudits.title: Bounded Google Drive folder authorization and scope boundary review
phaseAudits.previousClaim: Synthetic and live tests prove that selecting a folder authorizes the folder container resource itself
phaseAudits.groundTruth: Live runner (tests/spikes/drive/run-spike.mjs --mode=live) returned outcome=blocked due to missing owner Google Cloud OAuth credentials (missing_oauth_config). The boundary proof was demonstrated exclusively through synthetic simulation tests (tests/integration/phase107-drive-folder-boundary.test.ts); no live Google tokens or Drive access were obtained
phaseAudits.correctedClaim: Synthetic simulation tests prove that selecting a folder authorizes the container only and denies unpicked descendants; live OAuth execution was attempted and truthfully recorded as blocked (outcome=blocked, missing_oauth_config) due to lack of owner Google Cloud project credentials (DEF-V2-005); zero live Google tokens or Drive access were granted

phaseAudits.title: AI text-assistant release-gate and operational review
phaseAudits.previousClaim: Live provider wire protocol evaluated under OpenAiCompatibleProvider; Provider Separation: Live vs. Mock Evaluation
phaseAudits.groundTruth: OpenAiCompatibleProvider was tested strictly using synthetic local HTTP mock responses and simulated error handlers; no outbound cloud network calls to OpenAI or external LLMs occurred; enterprise live AI provider access remains blocked fail-closed under DEF-V2-008
phaseAudits.correctedClaim: Live provider wire protocol evaluated strictly using synthetic HTTP transport and local simulated server responses (store: false, 429/503/401 mappings); zero external outbound network requests made to third-party AI APIs; live transmission remains disabled fail-closed under DEF-V2-008

phaseAudits.title: Voice-assistant verification and operational review
phaseAudits.previousClaim: Bangla script Unicode preservation, English speech recognition, and Banglish fidelity verified; Gemini 1.5 Flash evaluated as primary live candidate
phaseAudits.groundTruth: Language recognition, script preservation, silence detection, and confidence scoring were tested using synthetic in-memory audio byte buffers and MockAudioTranscriptionAdapter in Vitest; Gemini 1.5 Flash was evaluated analytically for rate structure and theoretical suitability, not via live audio streaming over the network; physical phone microphone and spoken TalkBack were unavailable
phaseAudits.correctedClaim: Voice transcription, Bengali Unicode preservation, silence detection, and low-confidence flagging were evaluated using synthetic audio byte payloads and local mock adapters (MockAudioTranscriptionAdapter); live multimodal provider protocol was evaluated analytically without network streaming; physical microphone hardware and live cloud streams remain blocked fail-closed under DEF-V2-008 and DEF-V2-011
